title: Amazingly Aromatic Portuguese Chicken Tagine
description: A funky and creamy Portuguese dish featuring red pepper flakes, perfect for a lazy Sunday, cooked to perfection in a tagine, with a dash of friendly spices. This dish is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the chicken to the tagine and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the red pepper flakes, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the tagine and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Stir in the coconut cream and continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
